title: release cutover checklist - daily scratchpad
content:
Scratchpad - Release 1.22.0 cutover (oncall) - 2026-03-04
Owner: Samira Patel (oncall)

Context:
- This is the daily scratchpad for the release cutover window. Quick notes + runbook snippets.
- Primary goal: roll 1.22.0 to prod with minimal latency impact; ensure backports for hotfixes RINF-4521/RINF-4530 are included.
- Cutover window: 12:00 - 13:30 UTC (estimate).

PRE-CUTOVER CHECKS (T-30 -> T-5)
- Confirm reserved capacity warmed up on dedicated clusters (infra). Ticket: RINF-4521.
- Verify model caches pre-populated for top 10 prefixes (see caching playbook).
- Confirm canary traffic route configured: route -> canary-group (10% traffic).
- DB migrations: none planned. If deploy requires schema, block and run migration plan (NOTES below).
- Secrets/keys: KMS rotation already applied on 2026-03-01. Confirm env var propagation on private.
- Alerting: set temporary threshold for 95th pct latency -> 600ms, error rate -> 1%.
- Pager duty: confirm SRE on-call (Liam) + Eng leads (Priya) notified.

DEPLOY STEPS (high-level)
1) Merge final release PRs -> main (PR 1987 merged).
2) Kick off CI/CD pipeline -> staging deployment. Smoke test (smoketest script).
3) Promote to canary in us-west-2 (10% traffic) - monitor 15m.
   - Commands: 
     - kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/platform-inference
     - polylith promote --env=prod --service=platform-inference --tag=release-1.22.0
4) If canary stable, promote to 50% for 10m, then 100% (rolling).
5) Post-deploy: run verification checks (see below).

SMOKE/POST-DEPLOY VERIFICATION (quick list)
- /health -> 200 across 5 regions via k6 quick script.
- Sample prompt test: 50 runs median latency < 350ms. Use runbook script: tools/verify_cutover.sh
- Embedding accuracy smoke: run embedding sanity check against golden set (eval/embeds/golden.json).
- Check logs for spike in oo-memory or kv-cache misses.
- Ensure no backlog in request queue (> 500k tokens/min threshold).

BACKPORTS / HOTFIXES
- RINF-4521: backport patch to quantizer to avoid OOM on long context - PR 1992 (needs manual cherry-pick).
- RINF-4530: fix for streaming boundary bug - PR 1995 (already cherry-picked into release branch).
- Local steps: git checkout release/1.22 -> git cherry-pick <commit> -> run unit tests -> open PR -> deploy to staging.

ROLLBACK PLAN (fast)
- If latency > 600ms sustained for 10m or error rate > 2%: immediate rollback to release-1.21.
- Rollback commands: polylith promote --env=prod --service=platform-inference --tag=release-1.21.
- Notify customers via status page and Slack (#customer-facing) with short template below.
- Postmortem: capture timeline in Confluence, assign to oncall.

COMMS (who to ping / short templates)
- Internal Slack (release-cutovers): "Rolling 1.22.0 -> canary now (10%) — Samira P. Monitoring latency/errors."
- If rollback: "Rollback initiated to 1.21 due to elevated latency. Status page updated. Investigating root cause."
- External status page template (short): "We experienced increased latency after the 1.22.0 rollout at 12:18 UTC. We initiated a rollback to 1.21 and are monitoring. We will post updates every 15 minutes."

OPEN QUESTIONS / TODO (for follow-ups)
- Confirm whether dedicated pool autoscaler settings should be temporarily disabled during cutover (ask infra: @Liam).
- Double-check KV cache TTLs for conversation reuse — might need bump to 30m for heavy workloads.
- Confirm rollback cert rotation window with security if we need immediate secret swap.

QUICK COMMAND SNIPPETS (copyable)
- Promote canary: polylith promote --env=prod --service=platform-inference --tag=release-1.22.0 --traffic=10
- Rollback: polylith promote --env=prod --service=platform-inference --tag=release-1.21 --traffic=100
- Restart pods: kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/platform-inference
- Check logs tail: kubectl -n prod logs -l app=platform-inference -f --since=10m | grep -i oom

NOTES (misc)
- If backport PRs require manual testing, tag Priya for infra resource allocation.
- Keep release-channel slack updates terse — 1 line + link to incident page.
- This doc is my mutable scratchpad. Add quick notes here during cutover; will clean up into Confluence after.

LAST-MINUTE REMINDERS
- Keep phone on silent but near.
- Eat before window. Hydrate.

END SCRATCHPAD
